name: @cesarbenavides/fleet
description: Portable agent-swarm launcher + connection doctor: parallel agents over git worktrees & cmux/tmux surfaces, a live board + status/comms bus, plus OAuth/MCP connection auto-fix. Works in any git repo.
author: Cesar Benavides <cbenavides2527@gmail.com>

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --target=bun --outfile dist/index.js && mkdir -p dist/assets && cp -R ../../packages/swarm/assets/. dist/assets/ && chmod +x dist/index.js
